projects.title: E-Library Landing Page
projects.tagline: Landing page untuk platform digital library
projects.description: Dibuat waktu magang di Penerbit Erlangga untuk mengenalkan layanan digital library mereka ke pembaca baru. Flow halamannya saya buat ringkas: preview katalog buku, filter kategori, ulasan pembaca, sampai tombol download aplikasi, biar pengunjung langsung paham fiturnya.
features: Preview koleksi buku digital berdasarkan kategori populer
Pencarian cepat plus filter kategori, biar cari buku lebih gampang
Ulasan pembaca dan tombol download aplikasi yang jelas
Layout responsive yang enak dibaca di desktop maupun HP

annotations.label: Preview sampul buku
annotations.detail: Sampul buku jalan sendiri di bagian atas, jadi pengunjung bisa memindai koleksi tanpa harus klik pagination.

annotations.label: Smooth scroll Lenis
annotations.detail: Lenis menggantikan lompatan scroll bawaan browser, jadi pindah antar bagian terasa halus dan header tidak menutupi teks.

annotations.label: Animasi Framer Motion
annotations.detail: Blok fitur muncul satu per satu dengan urutan stagger, jadi urutan bacanya jelas tanpa halaman bergerak berlebihan.

personal.name: Yesaya Roy Nugraha
personal.headline: Frontend Developer & UI/UX Designer
personal.subheadline: Interfaces designed in Figma, then built into responsive websites with React and Tailwind CSS.
personal.bio: I design interfaces in Figma, then build them into responsive websites with React and Tailwind CSS. During my internship as a UI/UX & Front-End Intern at Penerbit Erlangga (Sep–Dec 2025), I built the landing page for their digital library platform.
personal.status: Open to full-time work and freelance projects

experience.description: Designed the interface and built the landing page for a digital library platform with React.js and Tailwind CSS. Mostly focused on keeping the book catalog layout tidy, light, and easy to navigate at any screen size.

projects.title: E-Library Landing Page
projects.tagline: Landing page for a digital library platform
projects.description: Built during my internship at Penerbit Erlangga to introduce their digital library service to new readers. I kept the page flow short: book previews, category filters, reader reviews, then the app download button, so visitors get the features right away.
features: Digital book previews organized by popular categories
Quick search plus category filters, so finding a book takes less effort
Reader reviews and a clear app download button
A responsive layout that reads well on desktop and mobile

annotations.label: Book cover preview
annotations.detail: Book covers scroll on their own at the top, so visitors can scan the collection without clicking through pagination.

annotations.label: Lenis smooth scroll
annotations.detail: Lenis replaces the browser's default jump, so moving between sections feels smooth and the header never covers the text.

annotations.label: Framer Motion animation
annotations.detail: Feature blocks show up one by one with a stagger, so the reading order stays clear without the page moving too much.

contact.ctaText: Open to full-time roles, freelance projects, or just a chat about UI/UX design and frontend.
